items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: This Tom, I'm talking about played trumpet, he died, he hadn't had so long.

ctx.x: Well, I knew Tom Harris, he was a bass player, the one that I knew.
This Tom, I'm talking about played trumpet, he died, he hadn't had so long. You're talking about Tom Alvin. Tom Alvin, yeah.
Well, Tom Harris was a bass player, he used to spin his bass around and, like Wally Pelt, you know.

items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Yeah he played guitar with me.

ctx.x: Well he used to play with me Eddie Dawson. Yeah Eddie Dawson. Well he used to play bass I think he did. Who did? No guitar. Eddie Dawson. Yeah. Yeah he played guitar with me. I just came down around the jump all around through there. I just carried a Dorsey. I just carried almost all of them.
This other Dorsey, what was he like? A bass player you say? Was he a good bass player?
